_readme: PRICECHARTING PAGE LINKS, AND NOTHING ELSE. 13 November 2026.
PriceCharting requires a paid plan to show their prices on a site like this and
the owner declined, so no number from PriceCharting is shown anywhere on the
site (shared/no-pricecharting.mjs refuses every request). What stays is the link
to each card's own page on pricecharting.com, which pages print as
"Graded prices on PriceCharting" so a visitor can look the graded value up there.
Keyed set slug, then card number. Frozen: nothing refreshes it. Written once from
the last data/pricecharting-cards.json before that file was removed.
